title: Process Exporter Metrics

fields.name: scrape_interval
fields.description: The rate at which metrics are collected.

fields.name: path.procfs
fields.description: The mount point used to collect process information and metrics.

fields.name: process_include_pattern
fields.description: regex to determine which names of processes are included in the metrics produced by this plugin
fields.default: It is applied for all process unless explicitly set. Default is `.+`.

fields.name: process_exclude_pattern
fields.description: regex to determine which names of processes are excluded in the metrics produced by this plugin
fields.default: It is not applied unless explicitly set. Default is `NULL`.

fields.name: metrics
fields.description: To specify which process level of metrics are collected from the host operating system.

fields.name: tag
fields.description: Tag assigned to records emitted by this input plugin.

description: Prometheus Node Exporter is a popular way to collect system level metrics from operating systems, such as CPU / Disk / Network / Process statistics.
